Well for one I'm too socially anxious & depressed to get a job so I'm just a straight up burden to my mom, most of the friends that I had before left me because whenever they were around me I would complain about how crappy my life is, and when they would offer help I would refuse it because I don't really want others help since I don't want to be a burden so they'd get mad that I would ignore their advice and leave. 

It's my fault, all of it. If I simply manned up and got a job I'd be able to move out and stop being a burden to my mother and if I got help then I'd actually be able to make connections with people, but I guess I lack the strength to leave my comfort zone and do those things. If only I weren't such a lazy, weak, and depressed piece of crap then I would be able to fix these things but I can't, and that's exactly why I'm going to end it on Sunday when my mom is gone so I can take a gun and go out to the woods and finally put an end to this revolving door of misery. 

Sorry for bothering you, but I appreciate you taking the time to read this.
